H1.definition: (B - A) / (max(B, D) - A), PR-AUC pooled over the pre-shift period

H2.definition: Rejected only if D - B, precision at k pooled pre-shift, is at least 5 points and its 95% interval excludes zero
H2.outcome: stands: the GNN does not clear the bar

H3.definition: Relative fall in mean per-step PR-AUC from pre-shift to post-shift; positive pair differences mean the more complex arm fell more
